scope: Specific topic labels for real Telegram messages; saved BF16 classifier runs.
reference_status: AI-authored, not independently human-verified; development comparison.
first_choice_rule: Exactly one highest-scoring evaluated label per message; no score threshold. Same previously selected model configurations and frozen 800 evaluation texts.
first_choice_denominator: First choice matches any positive reference label, on messages with at least one positive label. A selected uncertain reference pair is excluded from the denominator and reported separately.
displayed_metric: Top label accuracy: highest-scoring label is correct on messages with a matching reference label.
model_selection: Settings and score cutoffs chosen on 200 tuning messages; 800 scored separately. No new tuning for forced first-choice evaluation.
shortlists: GLiClass and GLiNER jointly score Nemotron 3 Embed 8B BF16 shortlists that fit their input. BGE-M3 and mDeBERTa score all 860 labels separately. Shortlist misses count as misses.

gliclass-mini.scope: Maximum input accepted by the classification pipeline used in this report.

gliclass-ultra.scope: Maximum input accepted by the classification pipeline used in this report.

gliner25.scope: Checkpoint max_len default, not a universal architecture ceiling.

bge-m3-nli.scope: 8,194 positional entries minus the XLM-R position offset of 2; the saved tokenizer default of 512 was overridden in this benchmark.

mdeberta-nli.scope: Tokenizer default and tested limit; relative attention does not impose a hard 512-token ceiling.

practical_limits.context_scope: Input limits used by the classification pipelines. Candidate counts depend on message and label lengths.
practical_limits.multiple_labels: These models support multiple labels. Tuned score cutoffs were used, but reliable separation of correct and incorrect labels has not been established for this task.
practical_limits.missing_context: No built-in not-enough-context answer. An empty label list does not distinguish missing information from no matching topic; a separate label or decision rule would be needed.
practical_limits.llm_comparison: Larger prompts and flexible generated responses are capabilities, not a measured LLM accuracy result in this report.
